intro: Connect RabbitMQ or Kafka. Follow the traffic, keep the interesting bits, leave application consumers alone.
emptyResources: Connect to a broker to explore its queues, streams and exchanges.
chooseQueue: Choose a queue to inspect its routes.
bindingHint: New traffic only. Existing backlog is not copied. Binding changes require refreshing this snapshot.
partialHint: Unsupported routes will be omitted. Mirroring adds broker load and can affect routing-existence checks.
noCapture: Choose a resource above to review coverage and start capture.
chooseMessage: Select a message to inspect its payload and properties.
sessionHint: Secure OS storage is unavailable or disabled for tests. Connections are kept in memory; temporary encrypted captures are removed on exit.
error: The operation failed. Check endpoints, permissions, settings and available disk space.
serviceError: The local service is unavailable. Restart QueueCumber to recover; active captures may have a gap.
appearanceHint: Keep your workspace comfortable for long debugging sessions.
limitsHint: Finite budgets, on your terms. The RAM budget controls message cache, not total application memory.
rate: Capture rate (messages/second, blank = no rate limit)
confirmEffects: Apply changed limits? Existing captures will stop; older retained messages may be evicted.
previewTruncated: Preview is limited. Original retained bytes are preserved on disk.
omission: This delivery was omitted because it exceeded a configured capture limit.
potentialOverflow: Broker buffer is finite; overload may cause uncounted gaps.
closeBehavior: Closing the window stops this MVP. Tray mode arrives in 0.2.
invalidSettings: Check positive values, units and budget relationships.
name: Name
futureResource: This resource can be explored; its subscription workflow is planned for a later milestone.
connectionHint: Credentials stay in privileged processes after saving. Use amqps:// and HTTPS for remote brokers.
stopBeforeSettings: Saving limits stops active captures so new budgets apply consistently.
chunkFailure: These bytes are no longer available. The retention limit may have removed this message.
bindingsChanged: Bindings changed during reconnect. The table shows the routes used by the current capture.
historyFailure: Could not save capture history. Captures have stopped; check disk space and storage settings.
backgroundHint: Keep captures running when closing the window. Quit QueueCumber stops captures and exits.
closeToTray: Keep running when the window closes
backgroundLinux: On Linux, closing keeps an accessible minimized window; tray visibility depends on your desktop.
backgroundUnavailable: The tray is unavailable. The window stays accessible when minimized.
desktopPreferencesWarning: Desktop preferences could not be read. Background close is off; review and save your preference.
closeBehaviorBackground: Closing the window keeps captures running. Use Quit QueueCumber to exit.
configurationHint: Transfer connection profiles between installations. Capture limits, appearance and OS keys stay on this computer. The entire file is password-encrypted.
configurationSecretsHint: Secrets are excluded by default: credentials, URL query parameters and custom CAs must then be entered again. Imports never connect automatically.
includeSecrets: Include credentials, URL parameters and custom CAs
importNoSecrets: This file excludes secrets; imported connections may need credentials and a custom CA before use.
importSessionOnly: Secure persistence is unavailable. Imported connections will exist only for this app session.
configurationError: Could not transfer configuration. Use a password of at least 12 characters; check the password, file integrity and permissions. If connections changed or the preview expired, import the file again.
deleteCaptureConfirm: Stop this capture and delete its retained messages and history? Previously exported files are kept.
dumpHint: Dumps contain plaintext private data. Only locally retained messages are exported; retention may remove messages during export. ZIP is limited to 10,000 messages; use JSONL or folder for larger captures.
exportFailed: Export failed. Check free disk space and destination permissions. Existing destinations are preserved on failure.
exportCleanupFailed: A partial export could not be removed. Inspect the chosen destination directory before retrying.
exportRecoveryCleaned: An interrupted export was cleaned up. Choose a new destination to export again.
exportRecoveryManual: An interrupted export needs manual cleanup in its destination directory.
streamHint: Read the stream without deleting its log. Choose a starting position; offsets outside broker retention may be clamped. No application consumer-group positions are changed.
streamOffsetChanged: The broker delivered a different offset than requested. Retention or non-message log positions may cause this; gaps are not an exact lost-message count.
streamRetention: Stream history is controlled by broker retention. Reconnect resumes after the last locally processed offset; unavailable positions may be clamped.
streamOffsetUnverified: The requested offset has not been confirmed by a delivery yet. Depending on retention and broker version it may wait for future data or attach to an available position.
editConnectionHint: Your saved settings are loaded for editing. Credentials remain local.
kafkaPositionHint: Choose up to 128 partitions with independent positions. Ranges show first retained → end (exclusive). Offsets are decimal 64-bit integers.
kafkaClamped: Expired prefix: resumed at the first retained offset.
kafkaAhead: Requested offset exceeds the end: attached at the live end.
kafkaTruncated: Log truncated: stop and start a new capture.
kafkaTopologyChanged: Partition set changed. This capture keeps its original selection; start a new capture to include new partitions.
kafkaHint: Read partitions with local offsets, without joining or committing to consumer groups. Includes uncommitted transactional records.
kafkaRetention: Broker retention and compaction control available offsets. Reconnect resumes locally; gaps are not exact lost-message counts.
guidedEndpoints: First, enter endpoints without credentials and choose the virtual host.
guidedCredentials: Now add credentials. The connection URL is assembled and encoded for you.
connectionFieldsInvalid: Check the fields and transport consent. Guided AMQP endpoints must contain only scheme, host and port; enter credentials and vhost separately.
captureGuide: Select a queue, stream or topic on the left. Review its routes or starting offsets, then choose Start capture. For sample traffic, follow the local demo guide in the README.
manualRouteHint: Choose a direct or topic exchange. Only the temporary observation queue is bound; the application queue stays unchanged. Topic wildcards are supported.
deleteConnectionConfirm: Remove this saved connection and its credentials? Active captures will stop. Capture history will be kept. Broker resources will not be changed.
connectionRemoved: This connection was removed. Saved captures remain available for inspection and export.
eggHint: You know the one. Keyboard or controller, your call.
eggBustedBody: Sadly, none of them clear a queue backlog. Your messages are waiting, and a few of them look like they're judging you. Quit fooling around and get back to work.
routesHint: Binds one temporary queue to every direct or topic exchange that routes these keys. New traffic only; application queues are not touched. Fanout, headers and default-exchange routes ignore the key and are skipped.
